branding.aboutUs: Welcome to 31 Kitchens! We are a home-grown kitchen dedicated to serving fresh, wholesome meals made with love and the finest ingredients. Our mission is simple — bring restaurant-quality food to your doorstep without the restaurant markup. Every dish is prepared to order, ensuring you always get the freshest meal possible. Thank you for supporting us!
branding.termsConditions:
By placing an order with 31 Kitchens, you agree to the following terms:

1. Orders once placed cannot be cancelled after preparation has begun.
2. Prices are inclusive of all applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.
3. Delivery times are estimates and may vary based on demand and location.
4. We reserve the right to refuse service in cases of misuse or fraudulent activity.
5. Payment must be completed before the order is dispatched.
6. For any disputes, please contact us directly via WhatsApp.

These terms are subject to change without prior notice.
branding.privacyPolicy:
Your privacy matters to us. Here is how we handle your information:

1. We collect only the information necessary to process your order (name, phone number, address).
2. Your details are never sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
3. Order data is stored securely and used solely for fulfilling and improving our service.
4. We may contact you via WhatsApp for order updates and occasional offers — you can opt out at any time.
5. By placing an order, you consent to our use of your information as described above.

For privacy concerns, reach out to us via WhatsApp.
